item.title: Physics-informed machine learning: a hybrid lens for fluid dynamics
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01319-4

A neural network approach bridging Lagrangian and Eulerian perspectives transforms sparse observations into physically accurate, high-resolution maps of complex and chaotic fluid motions.
item.dc:title: Physics-informed machine learning: a hybrid lens for fluid dynamics
item.dc:creator: Kai Fukami
Romit Maulik

item.title: Agentic inequality
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01318-5

Sharp et al. investigate the implications of unequal access to AI agents and of differences in their quality and number, developing a conceptual framework to identify potential sources of inequality and suggesting a research agenda to help address the resulting societal challenge.
item.dc:title: Agentic inequality
item.dc:creator: Matthew Sharp
Omer Bilgin
Iason Gabriel
Lewis Hammond

item.title: Lagrangian–Eulerian learning of flow field and trajectories with TrajectoryFlowNet
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01316-7

Wan et al. introduce a physics-informed learning model that simultaneously predicts long-range particle paths and flow fields based on very limited trajectory measurements, validated in both simulations and blood-flow experiments.
